Morgan: Heads-up — planning a simulated elevation drill tied to the quarterly access review next Wed 9am PT. Goal: exercise least-privilege enforcement, validate KMS audit log fidelity, and run through oncall escalation. High-level plan below — feedback? Volunteers?
Lina: +1. Can we keep blast radius to staging + a controlled read-only check in prod?
Sam: I can run the staging portion and script the temporary role grant. Will use `okta-cli grant --temp-role admin-readonly --duration 10m`.
Priya: Scope question — what signals should trigger a real pager vs drill-only alerts? don’t want to wake people for test noise.
Morgan: Good point. Drill alerts should be labeled `DRILL` and route to the test-policy pager. Real security triggers (unexpected KMS key usage outside expected principals) should escalate normally. We’ll add a flag on alerts.
Jane-SRE: Can you drop the preliminary runbook here? I need the exact queries so we can validate audit ingestion during the drill. Sample KMS audit query: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyRing.CryptoKeyVersion\" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:temp-elev" --freshness=30m`
Eli: Also capture the raw KMS audit line. Example snippet we expect: `{"protoPayload":{"methodName":"asymmetricSign","authenticationInfo":{"principalEmail":"svc-temp-elev@redwood.test"},"requestMetadata":{...}}}`
Sam: Will post the grant script and the `kubectl auth can-i` check we plan to run after elevation: `kubectl auth can-i create secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:staging:temp-elev`
Lina: I’ll own the alert flagging and will update the alerting rule: add label `drill=true` and suppress pager integration unless `drill=false`.
Priya: Anyone owning post-drill key hygiene? We should ensure any temporary keys or grants are revoked and that KMS key ACLs are unchanged.
Morgan: Eli + Sam to revoke and rotate any short-lived creds; Lina to confirm alerting behavior; Jane-SRE to validate logs and ingestion timestamps. I’ll create the ticket and assign.
audit-bot: Created ticket SECURITY-DRILL-2026 in the security board, assignees: Morgan, Sam, Eli, Lina, Jane-SRE.
Jane-SRE: One more thing — add a smoke check for log latency: compare event time to ingestion time with `jsonPayload.ingestLatencyMs < 120000` otherwise flag.
Eli: Noted. I’ll add a Cloud Logging metric to catch delayed KMS events.
Morgan: Thanks all. If no objections I’ll run the drill next Wed 9am PT, duration 20m. Volunteers please mark availability. Will post final runbook + commands here by EOD Monday. :thumbsup:
